questions.text: In a healthy 70-kg adult male at rest, the normal Total Renal Blood Flow (RBF) averages approximately:

options.A: 1200 to 1250 mL/min (20% to 25% of cardiac output)
options.B: 500 mL/min (10% of cardiac output)
options.C: 2500 mL/min (50% of cardiac output)
options.D: 125 mL/min (equal to GFR)
options.E: 650 mL/min (equal to renal plasma flow)

questions.explanation:
**Renal Blood Flow (RBF) &**: Total RBF = 1200-1250 mL/min (20-25% CO). Hematocrit ~45% -> RPF = ~650 High cortical flow generates high glomerular capillary pressure mL/min. Cortex receives ~90-93% (high flow for filtration); Medulla receives (Pgc ~50 mmHg); low medullary flow prevents countercurrent

**Distribution**: solute washout. ~7-10% (sluggish flow in vasa recta). A-V 02 extraction is very low (~10-15%) because blood flow massively exceeds metabolic demand.
